title: Zelensky Comment Raises Fear That U.S. Is Cutting Intelligence Sharing
description: The Ukrainian leader said Kyiv had no early warning from its Western partners before a Russian ballistic missile attack. But some such attacks do go undetected.

title: A Father’s Mission Is to Show the World ‘What Russia Did to My Family’
description: After a glide bomb killed his wife and younger daughter, Yevhen Ovcharov was determined to prevent other Ukrainians from dying the same way.

title: The Oct. 7 Attack Changed Israel, but Not Its Politics
description: As Israelis prepare to vote for the first time since the Hamas-led assault, they remain divided over whether to hold Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu responsible for negligence or fault the “treason” of his generals.

title: Trump attacks immigrants from Somalia and Haiti while rallying in Ohio for Republican candidates
description: At a rally in Ohio, Trump criticized Somali and Haitian immigrants to support Republican Sen. Jon Husted’s campaign and announced a new submarine component manufacturing center in Cleveland.

description: Sen. Chris Murphy, D-Conn., was denied access to Al Udeid Air Base, Qatar, during a recent Congressional Delegation trip in what he calls a "cover-up."

description: More than 100,000 Yemeni troops could be mobilized in the offensive, depending on the scale, officials said.

title: Russia says Europe bought $320 billion in hydrocarbons since 2022
description: Russia said on Monday that European Union countries had bought $320.7 billion worth of its energy resources since 2022, despite sanctions over the war in Ukraine. The figure fuelled tensions as European officials criticised a US deal to import Russian diesel, while Stockholm called for the bloc to use frozen Russian assets to boost support for Kyiv.

description: Iraq, Bahrain, Kuwait and Qatar face double-digit declines in GDP amid the fallout from the US-Israel war on Iran.

title: Despite long history with Netanyahu, Trump hedges as Israel vote nears
description: US president has not endorsed Israeli prime minister ahead of October 27 election amid shifting public sentiment.
